questions.question: What is the name of the sword reforged for Aragorn?
questions.note: Reforged from the shards of Narsil.

questions.question: Who brings Aragorn the reforged sword?
questions.note: He tells Aragorn to take the Paths of the Dead.

questions.question: What army does Aragorn summon from under the mountain?
questions.note: Oathbreakers, cursed until they fulfill their oath.

questions.question: To whom did the Dead swear the oath they broke?
questions.note: Only Isildur's heir can call them, which is why Aragorn can.

questions.question: Which two companions follow Aragorn onto the Paths of the Dead?
questions.note: Gimli: 'Certainty of death. Small chance of success. What are we waiting for?'

questions.question: Whose ships does Aragorn seize to sail to Minas Tirith?
choices: The Elves of the Grey Havens
questions.note: The Orcs on the Pelennor expect allies. They get the Dead.

questions.question: How many riders does Théoden muster to ride for Gondor?
questions.note: Less than half of what he hoped for.

questions.question: What vision makes Arwen turn back from sailing West?
questions.note: She sees the child she will have if she stays.

questions.question: What does Aragorn do with the Army of the Dead after the battle?
questions.answer: He releases them from their oath
choices: He releases them from their oath
He keeps them as his guard
He returns them to the mountain
questions.note: Gimli objects. Aragorn keeps his word.

questions.question: When Aragorn challenges Sauron through the palantír, what does Sauron show him?
questions.note: The Evenstar falls and shatters. Sauron means to break him.
